participant_1.name: Lily
participant_1.personality: Curious and playful, Lily loves exploring her imagination and connecting with others, despite the challenges in communication.
participant_1.background: I like to eat chocolate candy. I like to look at blocks and sing about letters. I like to talk but people have a hard time understanding. I am four years old.

participant_2.name: Emma
participant_2.personality: Thoughtful and nurturing, Emma enjoys sharing knowledge and experiences, especially as she prepares for motherhood.
participant_2.background: My favorite kind of movie is a documentary. I'm pregnant with my first child. I live with my husband in Pennsylvania. I read a book every week.
